The 3 `preferences` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## preferences.get

The person's preferences, which hold for every project and are kept in their own preferences file (not the project's): every preference section the editor and the engine's modules register (sections: id, title, category, description, version, schema: the JSON Schema of its value, value: what applies, isDefault: whether it is left at its default, problem: why a stored value is refused, null when none), in registration order; unclaimed lists sections the file stores that this editor does not know (kept as stored); file (null while the preferences are kept in memory only), fileState (written, writing or unwritten: its last write failed, preferences.save) and fileError; readOnly says why the file is left as it is (a later editor wrote it: this editor uses the defaults and changes nothing), null otherwise. section narrows sections to one. Works without a project. Set one with preferences.set.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Session` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPreferencesCommands.cpp:77`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `section` | string | no |   | A section's id (&quot;&lt;Module&gt;.&lt;Name&gt;&quot;, e.g. &quot;Editor.ExternalEditor&quot;) to describe alone. |

## preferences.save

Writes the preferences file now and answers once it is written: preferences are written in the background after every change anyway, so this is for after a write failed (preferences.get's fileState &quot;unwritten&quot;, fileError says why) once its cause is fixed, and for waiting until the file holds the latest change. Fails with the reason when the write fails, or when the file is left as it is (preferences.get's readOnly). Returns file (null while the preferences are kept in memory only: nothing is written then).

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPreferencesCommands.cpp:158`

No parameters.

<summary>Parameter schema of preferences.save</summary>

```json
}
```

</details>

## preferences.set

Sets one of the person's preference sections (preferences.get lists them with their schemas) to a value, or with reset: true back to its default. Preferences are the person's own and hold for every project: the change is not an undo step and leaves the project and the scene alone; the preferences file is written in the background (preferences.save waits for it). The value replaces the section's whole value and is checked by the section first: an invalid one changes nothing and fails naming what is wrong; it also fails while the file is left as it is (preferences.get's readOnly). Works without a project and while playing. Returns section, value (what applies now) and isDefault.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `settings` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPreferencesCommands.cpp:121`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reset` | boolean | no |   | Back to the section's default instead of a value (default false). |
| `section` | string | yes |   | The section's id, &quot;&lt;Module&gt;.&lt;Name&gt;&quot;. |
| `value` | any | no |   | The section's new value, matching its schema (preferences.get). |
